description: Third-party desktop client for Bilibili with video playback, danmaku and SponsorBlock
notes: BiliDesk keeps its settings, logs and image cache in "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\BiliDesk"; uninstalling the Scoop app leaves that folder behind.
The built-in update check only compares against GitHub Releases and opens the download page in your browser: run "scoop update bilidesk" to upgrade the installed copy.
